standard.summary: （实验性）DCT 频域损失：对训练预测结果进行 DCT 变换，在频域空间计算高低频分量的 loss，以约束特定频段的重建质量。
standard.effect: 高 high_weight = 加强高频（纹理/细节）的重建约束；low_cutoff 控制低/高频分界点。在某些噪声级别范围（min_t~max_t）内才激活。
standard.whenToUse: 实验性功能。对纹理细节要求高的 LoRA 训练（如皮肤纹理、布料质感）可以尝试。
standard.avoidWhen: 默认关闭。DCT 计算开销极小，但效果需要通过 A/B 对比验证。

standard_en.summary: (Experimental) DCT frequency-domain loss: applies a DCT to the training prediction and computes the loss on high- and low-frequency components separately, constraining reconstruction quality in particular bands.
standard_en.effect: A higher high_weight strengthens the constraint on high frequency (texture and detail); low_cutoff sets where low and high frequency divide. It activates only within a noise-level range (min_t to max_t).
standard_en.whenToUse: An experimental feature. Worth trying on LoRAs where texture detail matters (skin texture, fabric).
standard_en.avoidWhen: Off by default. The DCT itself costs almost nothing, but the benefit needs an A/B comparison to confirm.

advanced.principle: DCT loss = ||DCT(x_pred) - DCT(x_target)||² × W（频率加权矩阵），W 对高频系数放大 high_weight 倍。只在 sigma ∈ [min_t, max_t] 的步骤计算（避免对全噪声步骤无效约束）。
advanced.tradeoffs: DCT loss 与标准 MSE loss 不完全正交（低频 DCT ≈ MSE 的低频版本），需要确保 weight 不过大导致 loss 被 DCT 主导。

advanced_en.principle: DCT loss = ||DCT(x_pred) - DCT(x_target)||² × W (a frequency-weighting matrix), with W amplifying high-frequency coefficients by high_weight. Computed only on steps with sigma ∈ [min_t, max_t] (avoiding pointless constraints on fully-noised steps).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: DCT loss is not fully orthogonal to standard MSE loss (low-frequency DCT ≈ a low-frequency version of MSE); keep the weight from growing so large that DCT dominates the loss.
